signature: SUBROUTINE DORGQL( M, N, K, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix Q. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix Q. $M \ge N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q. $N \ge K \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the (n-k+i)-th column must contain the vector which defines the elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by DGEQLF in the last k columns of its array argument A. On exit, the M-by-N matrix Q.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The first dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by DGEQLF.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N)$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N \, \mathrm{NB}$, where NB is the optimal blocksize.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument has an illegal value
